purpose: Illustrative company introduction photograph; does not depict actual company staff or premises.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: a new editorial laboratory photograph for the company introduction section of KazProfLab's website. Generate a standalone photograph, no UI. Horizontal composition, 3:2 aspect ratio, high resolution.
Primary request: close-up of a researcher's two blue nitrile-gloved hands carefully using a modern white and blue micropipette to dispense a small drop of clear liquid into one glass sample vial on a clean steel laboratory workbench. A small row of glass sample vials and a realistic precision laboratory balance with a glass enclosure sit nearby. Only the hands and part of a white lab coat sleeve are visible; no faces.
Scene/backdrop: a credible modern working laboratory with glass partitions, restrained background equipment and real depth. Soft cool daylight through laboratory windows, subtle blue reflected light, neutral whites and stainless steel, clean deep navy shadows. Premium documentary photography rather than an advertising render.
Composition/framing: medium close-up at workbench level, action centered slightly to the right, clear foreground vial and hands, gently defocused balance and laboratory background, a few carefully composed objects, realistic lens depth of field. The image will be a large photo beside website prose and must remain useful when cropped slightly on mobile.
Materials/textures: natural skin folds visible only through realistic fitted gloves, authentic white coat fabric, transparent glass, brushed steel. Subtle restrained colors consistent with a navy and cyan laboratory website, but much more naturally daylight lit than a night-time hero.
Constraints: no text anywhere, no logos, no watermarks, no readable screens or labels, no fake certifications. This is an illustrative lab scene and should not depict identifiable real company staff. Exactly two anatomically credible hands, correct fingers, physically plausible grip and pipette tip alignment. No dramatic neon, no sci-fi, no floating objects, no surreal lab equipment, no decorative molecular graphics. Full bleed photograph, no border.
